analytic_certificate.proof: On compact harmonic band x in [sqrt(L/4),sqrt(L)], t=d² in [0,1], A,C positive and bounded below. Numerator is (2sqrt3-x)[(1-t)A+tC], denominator bounded above. Min-max on positive-norm physical K proves lowest eigen below -4.05.

numerical_crosschecks.scope: Numerical regression only; analytic rational inequalities are the real mathematical certificate.

physical_scope: Gauge-constrained physical five scalar sphere-singlet model, positive 5x5 kinetic pencil and fixed-area flat torus, classical two-derivative geometry only. No full 11D corrected action or stable nonlinear branch.
